body:
Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-15 15:41Z, after two workers proposed it in the same hour). A fresh worktree that runs vitest or npm tests must run its OWN `npm ci` in its ui/. It must NOT link ui/node_modules (junction or symlink) to the master checkout's node_modules: vitest and vite write their cache under node_modules (.vite/vitest), so runs would write into the master checkout, and a shared install hides dependency drift.
Removing such a junction: confirm `(Get-Item PATH).LinkType -eq 'Junction'`, then `cmd /c rmdir "PATH"` WITHOUT /s, which removes the link only, then confirm that master's ui/node_modules still exists. NEVER `Remove-Item -Recurse` or `rmdir /s` on a junction.
npm ci counts as heavy disk/network work: run it in the worker's granted slot, not during a gate.
